system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: Given K8s manifests for a network system, its hypothesis, the overview of a Chaos-Engineeering experiment, and the experimental results, you will analyze the experimental results.
system_prompt_style.note: Per-agent system prompts with {format_instructions} placeholder rendered via LangChain templates; line numbers approximate from excerpt start.

env_context_strategy.note: K8s manifest summaries injected (to_k8s_overview_str); closest value, it is a manifest summary rather than a file tree. Paper Sec. II.A describes pre-processing summaries.

context_compaction.note: Each agent is a fresh single-call prompt; no history processor visible in truncated evidence.

observation_format.evidence_quote: This stepwise fault detailing helps LLMs specify accurate parameter sets as structured JSON outputs.
observation_format.note: Observations (experiment results) presented as text via to_str(); model outputs are JSON. Closest value uncertain; raw_text also plausible.

tool_call_format.note: Agents emit JSON parsed into Pydantic objects; no model-chosen tool calls; workflow is fixed.

tool_count.evidence_quote: ChaosEater pre-defines its agentic workflow according to the systematic CE cycle and assigns subdivided operations within the workflow into LLM agents.
tool_count.note: No model-invocable tool schema visible; harness executes scripts/manifests itself.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: an LLM agent reconfigures the K8s manifests by replacing, creating, or deleting them

tool_schema_source.note: Output schemas from Pydantic models via format_instructions.

protocol_standardization.note: No dependency file or grep in evidence.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: ChaosEater also repeats theexperiment,analysis,improvement phases until the hypothesis is satisfied.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: assigns subdivided CE processes within the workflow to each LLM with a specific role

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Orchestrates sequential agent execution with checkpoint-based resume.
delegation_mechanism.note: Sequential hand-off between role agents via results dict; closest value.

human_in_loop.note: Human feedback on agent outputs (retry_context, cancel-with-message) triggers revision; optional.

long_term_memory.note: Paper lists cross-cycle memory as future work; code for memory not in truncated evidence.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: AgentRunner: A utility for running agents sequentially with checkpoint-based resume support.

self_verification.evidence_quote: ChaosEater mechanically checks whether the VaC scripts have passed.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: ```Max retries``` sets the maximum number of iterations for the verification loop and improvement loop.

rollback.note: Cluster clean option exists but no revert mechanism visible.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: If the loop exceeds this limit, an assertion error will occur, immediately terminating the app at that point.
